notes: Fixes Upload to QuickBooks XML parse error for orders containing non-ASCII characters (™, ®, em-dashes, accented chars, mojibake). The QBXMLRP2 SDK rejects payloads with high-codepoint characters even when the XML is well-formed, because pywin32 marshals Python str as UTF-16 BSTR and QB cannot reconcile that with the declared encoding. SKUs and descriptions are now stripped to printable ASCII before being put into the request. Special symbols are dropped (so Pirellone™ becomes Pirellone) but the rest of the description is preserved.
